question: A bow, a string, a bracer, a finger tab, a quiver, a bow stand, a bow stringer and a target to shoot at are equipment of _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Archery**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Archery** is a sport where participants use a bow to shoot arrows at a target to earn points based on accuracy.
 
• The essential equipment for archery includes a bow, arrows, a bracer (arm guard), a finger tab, a quiver, a bow stand, a bow stringer, and a target.
 
• A finger tab protects the archer’s fingers from the bowstring, while a bracer shields the forearm from injuries caused by the string’s impact.
 
• Archery has been practiced since ancient times for hunting and combat and has evolved into a popular sport and recreational activity.
 
• Modern archery, particularly recurve archery, is part of the Olympic Games, with a standard target distance of 70 meters for competitors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fencing**

 
 
• Fencing is a sport where participants compete using swords such as the foil, épée, or sabre.
 
• The objective is to score points by striking the opponent on the valid target area with the tip or edge of the weapon.
 
• Fencing equipment includes a sword, protective clothing (jacket, mask, gloves), and scoring sensors.
 
• The sport requires speed, strategy, and precision and has been part of the Olympic Games since their modern inception in 1896.
 
 
 
• **Shooting**
 
 
• Shooting is a precision sport involving firearms or air guns to hit stationary or moving targets.
 
• It includes various disciplines, such as rifle shooting, pistol shooting, and shotgun shooting, with events held over different distances and formats.
 
• Essential equipment includes firearms, ammunition, ear protection, and specialized clothing for stability and comfort.
 
• Shooting is also an Olympic event and requires a high level of focus and hand-eye coordination.
 
 
 
• **Bobsleigh**
 
 
• Bobsleigh is a winter sport where teams slide down an ice track in a gravity-powered sled at high speeds.
 
• The sport requires a combination of physical strength, teamwork, and precision to achieve optimal speed and control of the sled.
 
• Bobsleigh equipment includes a streamlined sled, helmets, and aerodynamic suits.
 
• The sport is contested in the Winter Olympics and is popular in countries with cold climates.
